notes.title: New Camera Modes Now Available
notes.notes: Several new camera modes are now available and can be selected from the main screen or camera settings menu.

notes.title: Starting Chapter Challenges Update
notes.notes: This update fixes a graphics issue when launching a chapter challenge from the "Play" screen.

notes.title: New rhythm visualizer has been added!
notes.notes: Check the bottom left corner of your screen for the new rhythm visualizer control. You can cycle through 14 different variants that will react to just about any sound you are playing through your speakers. Play your favorite music app during your next ride and give it a try!

notes.title: Fix Unlocking Steam Achievements
notes.notes: Unlocking Steam achievements now works on PC. We continue to work on addressing this issue for macOS.

notes.title: Biome Challenge Patch
notes.notes: Starting a challenge while in flying mode will now automatically transition you to the biking mode and begin the routine.
